intro: Around 9 out of 10 people living in the UAE are foreign residents, from more than 200 nationalities.

chapters.title: A mixed population
text: Emirati citizens are a small minority. Most residents come from India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, the Philippines, Egypt and elsewhere, working in building, services and business.
Arabic is the official language, but English is the everyday common language in shops and offices.

chapters.title: Life
text: Islam is the official religion, and other faiths have places of worship. Most people live in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone living outside their home country.
